subject: PostPond or Pause the reactiveness of a control

messages.author: e50e26b6da588f08
messages.subject: PostPond or Pause the reactiveness of a control
parts:
Hey Guys,

I have a page in my app where 4 controls are there each of which has it own re-activeness. When ever i change any of the control the graph distribution changes proactively.I have a new requirement where i wish to change all the 4 control and then see the changes in the distributed graph using a button click or submit button. So i don want the reactviness of the controls instantly upon changing its values.I would like to accomplish this task on click of submit button.Please help me out here.


Bala
